name: Data.cosetKernelSum_eq_fNatural
summary: Explicit matching for the block (W_j ⊕ I_j⁻ ⊕ L⁺, signed space) and the carrier identity give F♮ as an explicit_matching_of_sum; the coset sums are rewritten at the level rowStabilizer (stdClassSum_rowStabilizer_eq) and the line multipliers recognised; the constants combine into c(ϑ) with |c|² = C/heckeValueProd.

steps.claim: The signs of the padded space are blockSigns of the bijection built from regroupEquiv, basisVec and negIndex (proved at the end).
steps.lean:
have' hs : _ = blockSigns (.ofBijective (regroupEquiv j ∘ Sum.map (D.basisVec ∘ Fin.val (n :=
    D.posRank j)) inr ⊕ᵥ inr ∘ inl ∘ negIndex j) _) := _

steps.claim: For every ϑ: bigChar ϑ j·υ^m = twistedChi ϑ j·carrierChar j (proved at the end).
steps.lean: have e ϑ : bigChar ϑ j * WeilData.upsilonU1 ^ D.m = twistedChi ϑ j * carrierChar j := ?_
steps.typed_fact: bigChar ϑ j * WeilData.upsilonU1 ^ D.m = twistedChi ϑ j * carrierChar j

steps.claim: Explicit matching for the space W_j ⊕ … with posEquiv j and DetIndex j: constants and the matching identity hK.
steps.lean:
have' := (explicit_matching _ (.refl _) · 1 (posEquiv j) _ hs _ _ (DetIndex j))
  choose _ _ _ hK using this

steps.claim: The carrier identity: constants and hM (stdClassSum_carrierXi_eq_carrierForm, m even).
steps.lean: choose _ _ _ hM using stdClassSum_carrierXi_eq_carrierForm D.E D.m_even

steps.claim: Split the existential statements (C and c remain to be determined).
steps.lean: repeat constructor

steps.claim: For each ϑ, with hν the tameness of twistedChi·carrierChar: F♮_i = (explicit_matching_of_sum with hM, the modulus ϖ̄² ⊆ ϖ̄²Q and hK at η = detRows j i.2) — the matched polynomials agree with linePoly times the paired determinants (matchedPoly, letterMinor, posRowIndex: entrywise); the identity of the coset sums is left.
steps.lean:
refine fun ϑ ↦ let hν := (isTameFor_twistedChi j ϑ).mul (carrierChar_hasWeight ..); .symm ⟨fun u i
      g w H ↦ .symm (.trans ?_ (explicit_matching_of_sum _ _ hν (hM (isTameFor_twistedChi j _))
      (D.untwistedModulus 2) levelModulus_ideal_le _ fun _ _ h _ ↦ (hK _ hν
      (by simp [← card_detIndex_add_bigCharExp j]) (detRows j i.2) h (bigChar ϑ j) _ :).trans (by
    congr! <;> simp [← e, matchedPoly, pairedDetProd, letterMinor, ← mul_assoc, linePoly,
      prod_sigma, AlgHom.map_det, Matrix.map, ← Finset.prod_mul_distrib]
    congr! 4; omega; rw [← Fin.prod_const]; congr!
    repeat ext; simp [entrywise, inclMatrix, posRowIndex] <;> split <;> rfl))), ?_⟩

steps.claim: Exchange the class sums and pull out constants.
steps.lean: simp_rw [@classSum_comm (Gf _ (BigIndex j)), ← mul_classSum]

steps.claim: Rewrite the class sum over K₀ with the datum χ(det x″)F(x″⁻¹x′) as the class sum at the level of rowStabilizer (forgetTwist, w, inl ∘ inl) with the column datum (stdClassSum_rowStabilizer_eq: the Fock vector of the determinant product is fixed by the real Weil action, realPairWeil_stackedDetProd; F(y) = Σ_k ψ′(tr(y k·i.1)) is invariant under the stabiliser).
steps.lean:
refine congrArg _ (.trans ?_ congr(stdClassSum _ fun _ ↦ _ * $(stdClassSum_rowStabilizer_eq hν (by
    rw [hs]; simpa [-regroupEquiv] using! realPairWeil_stackedDetProd _ _
      (funext (by simp [← card_detIndex_add_bigCharExp j])) (detRows j i.2) 1) (forgetTwist _) w
    (.trans .inl .inl) (F := fun y ↦ ∑ k : GL _ _, traceChar i.1 (y.map (forgetTwist _) * k.1))
    fun A a ↦ by simp [traceChar, Matrix.mul_assoc, trace_mul_comm (A.1.map _), ← H, a.2])))

steps.claim: Exchange the class sums, use step 2, unfold cosetKernelSum and compare at each h.
steps.lean:
simp_rw [mul_classSum, @classSum_comm (Gf _ D.CarrierIndex), ← e,
    cosetKernelSum]; congr with h; clear * -

steps.claim: The goal is an identity of the bilinear kernel of W_j at the column datum and the letter polynomial.
steps.lean:
change modKernelBilin (D.spaceW j) _ _ _ _ _ _ (columnDatum _ (forgetTwist _) _ _) (letterPoly _
    _ 1 (untwistedAuxPair j).colsPlus _) = _

steps.claim: Expand the line multiplier vector in the standard basis.
steps.lean: rw [pi_eq_sum_univ' (lineMultiplier ϑ j i h)]; symm

steps.claim: Unfold lineMultiplier and the class sums; combine the kernels of the two blocks by the seesaw identity (modKernel_sum_left).
steps.lean:
simp [lineMultiplier, modKernelI, mul_classSum, ← classSum_sum, mul_left_comm (modKernel ..),
    mul_assoc, -mul_ite, ← Finset.mul_sum, mul_comm (modKernel (.sum ..) ..),
    ← modKernel_sum_left, -regroupEquiv]; congr!

steps.claim: Relabel the space along regroupEquiv (modKernel_reindex) and use linearity.
steps.lean:
erw [← modKernel_reindex (regroupEquiv ..).symm ?_ (.refl _) rfl,
    ← map_sum ((modKernelBilin ..) _), modKernelBilin_apply]; congr! -closePost 1; rfl

steps.claim: The relabelled group elements agree (Space.reindex, Space.sum).
steps.lean: ext1; simp [GeneralLinearGroup.ext_iff, Space.reindex, Space.sum]

steps.claim: Signs: the counts of negative signs agree (card_neg_signsW).
steps.lean: rfl; grind [pow_sub_mul_pow, card_neg_signsW, auxPair]

steps.claim: The data agree: lPlusDatum is the indicator condition with the trace sum.
steps.lean: congr! 2; simp [lPlusDatum, ← ite_and]; congr

steps.claim: Entrywise comparison of the inclusion conditions.
steps.lean: simp [entrywise, inclMatrix, forall_and, -sum_sum_type]; tauto

steps.claim: The determinant product is Σ_l P_l·Q_l with the letter polynomials of the basis and the line coordinates (stdClassSum_carrierXi_eq_lineMultiplier).
steps.lean:
simpa [Prod.map_comp_map, ← comp_assoc, -regroupEquiv] using!
    stdClassSum_carrierXi_eq_lineMultiplier j _ inl (inr ∘ inr)

steps.claim: The block group elements agree (G.ext_mat, entrywise).
steps.lean: apply G.ext_mat; simp [entrywise, Prod.ext_iff, funext_iff, U.sum]; iterate 3 aesop

steps.claim: The constants: |c(ϑ)|² = C/heckeValueProd j ϑ from the moduli of the matching and carrier constants (lValueProd of the three pairs, places of the modulus).
steps.lean:
simp [← Complex.ofReal_pow, mul_pow, div_pow, heckeValueProd, places_modulus_eq_union, *,
    linePair, eSign, ← division_def,
    div_right_comm _ (_ * _), div_mul_div_comm]; with_reducible congr

steps.claim: The character identity of step 2 (exponents of υ and χ; match_scalars, grind with heckeCount).
steps.lean:
any_goals clear * -; apply_fun ofMul; simp [bigChar, liftChar, twistedChi, carrierChar, μ₀];
            match_scalars <;> grind [heckeCount]

steps.claim: The signs of step 1: the bijection is injective and the signs match (signsW, basisVec).
steps.lean:
all_goals simp [↓card_rowIndex, ↓bijective_iff_injective_and_card, Injective, signsW, funext_iff,
    ↓Equiv.eq_comp_symm, apply_dite (padSigns j), basisVec]; grind [Equiv.injective, heckeCount]

steps.claim: (Not part of this proof: the line `unseal Finset.univ Finset.prod`, a command after the declaration, which the line census attaches to the lines of this one.)
steps.lean: unseal Finset.univ Finset.prod
